The lint rules crate compiles user patterns with RegexBuilder::size_limit(8 * (1 << 20)), and patterns over that limit return Error::CompiledTooBig, with the rule loader reporting the rule id instead of aborting. ## Summary

Investigated and fixed pod evictions on worker-node-7 by diagnosing DiskPressure caused by /var/lib/containerd being 94% full of unused images; root cause was imageGCHighThresholdPercent raised to 95 in the kubelet config.
